Pass 40 (built green): chunk designation gate (VERIFIED), multi-hop relay hauling (VERIFIED both dirs pending), pull-side fetch awareness, and now cross-level storage-UPGRADE pull: an item already in lower storage is moved to a strictly-better stockpile anywhere in the column (e.g. sky Normal -> basement Critical), with the verdict picking the highest-priority destination (no bounce-back).
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene for DBH, Krkr.rule56 for CAI, Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". NOTE: the auto-PIN of that palette entry can log "Could not find node from path ... Removing." at startup - run it manually from the debug menu. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (pass 33)** — except we programmatically re-stamp the vanilla Haul designation on a chunk set down mid-relay (p40 FIX 5), internal plumbing.
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING / STORAGE-PRIORITY doctrine (pass 37, REFINED p40):** ONE BIG MAP for storage priority. A cross-level storage move fires ONLY when the destination tier STRICTLY beats the best storage the item can reach on its OWN level. Equal/lower never crosses. `TargetLevelFor` now evaluates BOTH linked levels and keeps the STRICTLY-HIGHER-priority destination (was upper-first) - so an item goes to the best tier in the column and a relay stack continues toward it instead of bouncing back the way it came. Allow Tool Haul Urgently (ignorePins) still crosses. Monotone.
- **HAULABILITY PARITY (p40, USER-VERIFIED):** cross-level auto-haul mirrors vanilla. A non-alwaysHaulable thing (stone/slag chunk) is only auto-hauled when DESIGNATED (Orders->Haul) or already in storage; corpses alwaysHaulable, unaffected.
- **MULTI-HOP HAULING (p40, "stop at first level that accepts it"):** a stack whose only accepting storage is 2+ levels away is moved ONE gap at a time and stored at the NEAREST accepting level. Execution = one-hop-then-relay: `AB_HaulChainAcrossLevels` hop toward the far destination; `CrossLevelHaulChain.OnArrive` STORES here if this level accepts, else SETS THE ITEM DOWN and re-stamps the Haul designation (non-alwaysHaulable only) so the ordinary single-hop / far givers carry it onward. No re-entrant carried-item follow-up job.
- **PULL-SIDE (p40 FIX 6 + FIX 7):** the idle FETCH giver (`WorkGiver_ABFetchFromOtherLevels`) is far-destination aware AND scans a target level's IN-STORAGE items for cross-level UPGRADES (an item in valid best LOCAL storage is dropped from vanilla's haulables lister, so only a pawn on that level would push it). So an idle pawn on level A goes to level B to START a haul / upgrade that no pawn was standing on. `CanStartFor` intentionally NOT gated on VirtualScanActive.
- **COMBAT:** projectiles spawn on the TARGET map. VISUALS (p38): real 1:1 projectile. FoW (p39): optional CAI 5000.
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (p35):** foreign types never in a SIGNATURE/field. CAI reflection-only.
- **RE-ENTRANCY HARD RULE (p40):** re-entering a patched vanilla method, a foreign prefix may skip the original and leave nulls; coalesce. Also do NOT TryTakeOrderedJob re-entrantly from a stair-transfer callback that carries an item - set it down + re-designate instead.

# PASS 40 — HAUL/MENU FIX WAVE (BUILT GREEN 0/0, verifying in-game)
- **FIX 1** bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback.
- **FIX 2** cross-level RMB red error (Melee Animation postfix NRE) - coalesce re-entrant result/context.
- **FIX 3** equal-tier storage never crosses.
- **FIX 4** vanilla HAULABILITY PARITY (chunks need Orders->Haul or in-storage). USER-VERIFIED.
- **FIX 5** MULTI-HOP hauling via one-hop-then-relay (drop + re-designate). USER-VERIFIED upward ("this all seems to work").
- **FIX 6** FETCH far-destination aware (idle pawn goes to another level to start a 2+ gap haul). USER-VERIFIED.
- **FIX 7** (this pass) cross-level storage-UPGRADE pull + best-of-up/down. USER REPORT: item in top (sky) Normal storage; user makes a basement Critical stockpile; items never moved down. TWO causes: (a) the sky item is in its best LOCAL storage so vanilla drops it from the haulables lister -> the pull side never saw it (only a pawn on the sky would). Fixed: the fetch giver now also scans a target level's IN-STORAGE items (`AllGroupsListForReading` -> `HeldThings`, bounded by the examine budget) for a strictly-better cross-level storage. (b) once set down on the surface mid-relay, `TargetLevelFor` picked upper-first and bounced it back up into the Normal sky storage. Fixed: evaluate both levels, keep the strictly-higher-priority destination.

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56) (phases 1-3 built green, pending verify)
# 38 COMBAT VISUALS · 37 STORAGE-PRIORITY HAUL · 36 ONE-BIG-MAP WORK (VERIFIED) · 36b AIM POSE (VERIFIED) · 36c MODDED TURRET · 35 DBH/GRAVSHIP/DELETE/LEVELGEN · 34 · 33 SEE-BELOW INPUT (VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json (inert without MDT).

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (r7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (r12). Stairwell heat exchange. CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (p38). Equal-tier lateral cross-level storage moves (p40). Auto-haul of UNDESIGNATED loose chunks (p40). Carried-item re-entrant multi-hop continuation (p40, replaced by drop+re-designate). Upper-first destination pick (p40 FIX 7, now best-of-up/down).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · mech charge · bill supply + mech RMB · p33 see-below input · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose · **p40 chunk designation gate (FIX 4), multi-hop relay upward (FIX 5), pull-side fetch (FIX 6)**.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · **Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk cross-level; heavy-stack fallback; far chain single-item)** · Allow Tool · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39) · Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus (p40 coalesce) · turrets: any Building_Turret w/ projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 40 (TOP):**
- FIX 7 (current): item in a Normal SKY stockpile, then build a Critical BASEMENT stockpile (2 levels down), pawns on the surface -> the item must be carried sky->surface->basement into the Critical store and NOT bounce back up. Also test the 1-hop version (surface Normal -> basement Critical) and the reverse (basement Normal -> sky Critical).
- FIX 5/6 (re-verify no regression): basement designated chunks -> sky stockpile; stop-at-first-accepting when a surface stockpile exists.
- FIX 4 (VERIFIED) · FIX 3 (equal priority) · FIX 1 (Mehni.PickUpAndHaul no loop) · FIX 2 (co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation no red RMB error).
**PASS 39 CAI 5000** (Krkr.rule56). 38 · 37 · 36c · 35 queues.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement/light/RMB/below-view diagnostics · cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub self-tests · CAI fog self-test (p39).

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 40, BUILT GREEN 0/0, verifying in-game): chunk gate + multi-hop relay (upward) + pull-side fetch USER-VERIFIED ("this all seems to work"). Fixed the last reported bug: a Normal-stored item did not move to a newly-built Critical stockpile 2 levels down because (a) the pull side never saw it (in best LOCAL storage, dropped from the haulables lister) and (b) the relay bounced it upper-first. FIX 7: fetch now scans in-storage cross-level upgrade candidates, and `TargetLevelFor` keeps the strictly-higher-priority of the two linked levels. Testing ISOLATED + dev column; PUAH + Melee companions.
